# rasuvaeff/yii3-workflow-db

Compact API reference for LLM coding assistants.

## Install

```
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-workflow-db
./yii migrate:up --path=@vendor/rasuvaeff/yii3-workflow-db/migrations
```

## Rules

- This package only implements `Rasuvaeff\Yii3Workflow\Audit\TransitionLog`. All
  workflow behaviour lives in `rasuvaeff/yii3-workflow` (over symfony/workflow).
- It is the ONE source binding `TransitionLog` in DI; the core deliberately
  leaves that key unbound, and two vendor packages binding it would break
  `yiisoft/config`.
- Idempotency is enforced by a UNIQUE index on
  `(workflow, subject_id, idempotency_key)`. `hasIdempotencyKey()` is only a
  pre-flight check; `append()` is the guarantee and throws
  `DuplicateIdempotencyKey` on violation, which `IdempotentWorkflow::applyOnce()`
  reports as `false`.
- The audit row is written INSIDE `apply()`, after the subject was mutated in
  memory. Wrap `applyOnce()` + the entity save in one transaction, otherwise a
  lost race can still be persisted.
- A NULL idempotency key repeats freely; a non-null one is unique per subject.
- Timestamps are stored as ATOM strings (`string(30)`), so ordering is
  lexicographic on every driver; `id` order equals chronological order.
- Nothing reads the history back at runtime — retention is policy, hence
  `prune()` and `workflow:transitions:prune`.
- Tests run on in-memory SQLite; the schema in tests mirrors the migration and
  must be kept in sync with it.

## Configuration (params.php)

```php
'rasuvaeff/yii3-workflow-db' => [
    'table' => 'workflow_transitions',
    'retentionDays' => 90,
],
```

## API reference

```php
namespace Rasuvaeff\Yii3WorkflowDb;

final readonly class DbTransitionLog implements \Rasuvaeff\Yii3Workflow\Audit\TransitionLog
{
    public function __construct(ConnectionInterface $db, string $table = 'workflow_transitions');

    /** @throws \Rasuvaeff\Yii3Workflow\Audit\DuplicateIdempotencyKey */
    public function append(TransitionRecord $record): void;

    /** @return list<TransitionRecord> chronological */
    public function forSubject(string $workflow, string $subjectId): array;

    public function hasIdempotencyKey(string $workflow, string $subjectId, string $key): bool;

    /** @return list<TransitionRecord> newest first */
    public function latest(string $workflow, int $limit = 50, int $offset = 0): array;

    /** @return int deleted rows */
    public function prune(\DateTimeImmutable $before): int;
}

namespace Rasuvaeff\Yii3WorkflowDb\Command;

final class WorkflowTransitionsPruneCommand extends Command   // workflow:transitions:prune
{
    public function __construct(DbTransitionLog $log, ClockInterface $clock, int $defaultDays = 90);
}
```

## Schema

```
workflow_transitions
  id              bigint pk
  workflow        string(64)   not null
  subject_id      string(128)  not null
  transition      string(64)   not null
  from_place      string(512)  not null    -- comma-joined for Petri nets
  to_place        string(512)  not null
  at              string(30)   not null    -- ATOM
  idempotency_key string(128)  null

  index  idx_workflow_transitions_subject     (workflow, subject_id, id)
  index  idx_workflow_transitions_at          (at)
  unique uq_workflow_transitions_idempotency  (workflow, subject_id, idempotency_key)
```

## Console

```
./yii workflow:transitions:prune                     # configured retentionDays
./yii workflow:transitions:prune --older-than=30
./yii workflow:transitions:prune --older-than=30 --dry-run
```

## Minimal example

```php
$this->db->transaction(function () use ($order, $requestId): void {
    if (!$this->registry->get('order')->applyOnce($order, 'ship', $requestId)) {
        return;   // replay
    }

    $this->orders->save($order);
});

$history = $this->log->forSubject('order', $order->getId());
```
